scope: Repository source and documented pack contracts; not a new hosted qualification or official Auto Trader API claim.

claims: The pack supplies presentation and context while runtime assignment, knowledge, authorization and integrations stay outside it.
One-script installation, configured origins, both delivery forms and scoped connection profiles are distinct from stock synchronization.
Browse/context tools, safe media and host-owned detail mappings are configuration-driven.
Page attachments do not grant trusted resource authority; request and human-transition outcomes must be reported honestly.
limitations: No guarantee of Auto Trader production access, real retailer data, provider-side deal creation, booked appointments or response SLA.
The older demo README's direct-backend stock diagram is not used as the current installation contract.
